title: Deduplicate bridge oracle card field population
description: `BridgeCallbackHandler.populateCardFields()` has parallel mapping logic for `CardView` and `CardInfo` sources. Both paths populate mana cost, type line, rules text, creature stats, loyalty/defense values, and second-face data into the MCP oracle-text response. Consolidate the shared field-population behavior so schema changes and bug fixes for oracle responses only need to be made once while preserving the current source-specific lookups.
